title: AI Builders Digest — 2026-11-12
subtitle: 当模型成为标配，真正稀缺的是视角、责任和把 AI 放进真实工作流的能力。

intro.text: 今天的 feed 有一条很清楚的暗线：AI 能力正在变成基础设施，但价值并没有因此消失，而是在往更靠近工作现场、更靠近个人判断的地方移动。Dan Shipper 说，模型生成可能性很便宜，知道哪些值得行动才难；Aditya Agarwal 把创业机会分成两层，一层是把 AI 扩散到工作现场，另一层是用 AI 加速科学进展；Google Labs 则把这种能力做成了一个让普通人和朋友一起创造的空间。与此同时，Guillermo Rauch 提醒大家，产品依然需要人的注意力、努力和爱。

archive.title: 判断力迁移日报
archive.desc: 模型能力继续下沉到工作流、家庭空间和科学研发，真正的差异化转向人的视角、责任与产品判断。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-11-12 source feeds.

sections.title: The Human Edge / 人的优势还在判断

rewrite: Every CEO Dan Shipper argues that AI raises the floor for everyone, so the default answer becomes less valuable. The scarce part is the perspective and responsibility that let someone decide which possibility matters enough to act on.

His customer-survey example is unusually concrete: the same data and models produced a sales opportunity, a churn diagnosis, a community insight, and a Claymation game, depending on who looked at it. Generation is cheap; ranking and taking responsibility are still the team’s job.
original: Could you ask Claude to produce what each of them found? Maybe. But generating possibilities is cheap. Knowing which ones matter is hard.
The value is in using your perspective and responsibility to push past the baseline.

rewrite: Every CEO Dan Shipper 认为，AI 会把所有人的能力底线一起抬高，于是模型的默认答案反而没那么值钱了。真正稀缺的是一个人的视角和责任感，它们决定了哪些可能性值得被挑出来、继续做下去。
他的客户调研例子很具体：同一份数据、同一组模型，不同的人看出了销售机会、流失原因、社区洞察和 Claymation 游戏。生成很便宜，排序、判断并承担行动后果，仍然是团队的工作。
original: 让 Claude 生成每个人发现的东西？也许可以。但生成可能性很便宜，知道哪些重要却很难。
价值在于用你的视角和责任感，越过模型给出的基线。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch offers a useful counterweight to the automation narrative: wonderful products still demand extraordinary human focus, effort, motivation, love, and attention span. AI may compress execution, but it does not remove the need to care deeply about the result.
original: creating wonderful products still requires extraordinary amounts of human focus, effort, motivation, and love. And an attention span.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 给自动化叙事加了一块重要的配重：做出真正好的产品，依然需要大量的人类专注、努力、动力、爱，以及持续注意的能力。AI 可以压缩执行成本，但不会替你在乎结果。
original: 做出精彩产品，仍然需要大量的人类专注、努力、动力和爱，也需要注意力持续在线。

sections.title: AI Moves Into the Room / AI 进入真实空间

rewrite: Google Labs introduces Tabletop, an experiment built around a simple shift: instead of asking people to learn a tool, give a group one shared space where links and files can become whatever the moment needs. Road-trip maps, dinner wheels, pickleball brackets, seating charts—the product is intentionally specific and social.
original: Drop links and files into one shared space, add your crew, and ask Tabletop for whatever you need to create custom spaces on the fly.

rewrite: Google Labs 发布了 Tabletop，一个很有意思的方向是：不要求用户先学会一套工具，而是给一群人一个共享空间，让链接和文件在当下变成他们需要的东西。公路旅行地图、晚餐抽签轮、匹克球赛程、座位表，产品故意做得具体、社交，而且临时。
original: 把链接和文件放进一个共享空间，加入你的朋友，然后让 Tabletop 随时帮你创建需要的定制空间。

rewrite: Claude’s latest showcase is not another software demo: artist Mariko Mori used Claude to write code for a computer-generated animation in her retrospective All That Shines. The interesting part is the medium disappearing into the artwork—the audience sees the installation, not the model.
original: For her retrospective "All That Shines," she used Claude to write code for a computer-generated animation, presented as a new video installation.

rewrite: Claude 这次展示的不是又一个软件 demo：艺术家 Mariko Mori 在回顾展 All That Shines 中使用 Claude 编写计算机生成动画的代码，并把它呈现为新的影像装置。更有意思的是，技术正在从作品表面消失，观众看到的是装置，而不是模型。
original: 她在回顾展《All That Shines》中使用 Claude 编写计算机生成动画的代码，并将其呈现为新的影像装置。

sections.title: Where the New Companies Are / 新公司往哪里长

rewrite: SPC General Partner Aditya Agarwal sees two broad company-building opportunities. The first is diffusion: bringing AI close to where work happens, the AI-era version of vertical SaaS. The second is frontier: using AI to accelerate science and then turning those advances into products.

He points to drug discovery, genomics, venom research, and semiconductor multiphysics as examples of the less visible category. His thesis is that most model-driven returns may ultimately come from this harder-to-see frontier layer.
original: There are basically two kinds of companies to build right now: Diffusion of AI and Frontier of AI.
Category 2 is not well understood or much talked about externally. It should be because I think that is where the vast majority of model driven returns will come from.

rewrite: SPC General Partner Aditya Agarwal 认为，现在大体有两类公司机会。第一类是扩散：把 AI 送到工作真正发生的地方，可以理解为 AI 时代的 vertical SaaS。第二类是前沿：用 AI 加速科学进展，再把这些进展变成产品。
他举的例子包括药物发现、基因组学、毒液研究和半导体多物理建模。这一类机会不那么容易被外部看见，但他的判断是，未来大部分由模型驱动的回报，可能都来自这层更深的前沿。
original: 现在基本有两类公司可以做：AI 的扩散，以及 AI 的前沿。
第二类还没有被外界充分理解或讨论，但我认为绝大多数模型驱动的回报都会来自这里。

rewrite: Investor Nikunj Kothari scraped the subprocessor lists of 803 companies to map what AI-native companies actually use. His previous snapshot found multi-model setups rising from 33% to 44%, inference providers from 22% to 33%, and Typesafe AI emerging from zero to a noticeable presence.
The caveat matters: subprocessor lists lag reality. But they are still a useful evidence trail because companies must disclose who is handling their data.
original: I scraped 803 companies sub-processors to investigate what AI native companies are using for their infrastructure.
Subprocessor lists tend to be a lagging indicator, but a sure shot way of knowing if the company is using something.

rewrite: 投资人 Nikunj Kothari 抓取了 803 家公司的 subprocessor 列表，试图看清 AI-native 公司到底在用什么基础设施。他上一次快照显示，多模型供应商的比例从 33% 升到 44%，列出 inference provider 的比例从 22% 升到 33%，Typesafe AI 也从零变成了明显的参与者。
需要注意的是，subprocessor 列表会滞后于真实使用情况。但它仍然是一条有价值的证据链，因为公司必须披露哪些服务商在处理自己的数据。
original: 我抓取了 803 家公司的 subprocessor，研究 AI-native 公司到底在用什么基础设施。
Subprocessor 列表通常是滞后指标，但它是确认公司是否在使用某项服务的可靠方法。

sections.title: Coding Agents, Next / Coding agent 的下一步

rewrite: Former Claude Code builder Thariq frames his upcoming talk around a practical question: what should the experience of using coding agents feel like next year, and how can builders shape that experience now? The point is less a product announcement than an invitation to design the interaction model before it hardens.
original: it’s about how I think the experience of using coding agents could be like next year and how we get to shape it

rewrite: 前 Claude Code builder Thariq 把下一场分享的问题定得很实用：明年使用 coding agent 的体验应该是什么样，我们现在又能怎样参与塑造它？这不只是产品预告，更像是在提醒 builder：交互方式还没有完全定型，现在仍然是可以设计它的窗口期。
original: 这场分享会讲我认为明年使用 coding agent 的体验可能是什么样，以及我们如何去塑造它。

sections.title: One Long Listen / 一期值得听完的播客

rewrite: In A New Vision for Human Work After Automation, Every co-founder and CEO Dan Shipper makes a case for looking at AI through two lenses: the aggregate capability curve and the intimate details of one real team. The first can make human work look doomed; the second shows why responsibility and perspective still matter.

His sharpest idea is that teams are valuable because each person filters the same model through a different responsibility. As models become broadly available, the default output becomes the floor. What remains rare is the human who can decide what matters, then act on it.
original: A New Vision for Human Work After Automation

rewrite: 在《A New Vision for Human Work After Automation》中，Every 联合创始人兼 CEO Dan Shipper 提出了两种观察 AI 的方式：看整体能力曲线，和贴近一个真实团队的具体工作。前者容易让人觉得人类工作正在消失，后者则能看见责任与视角为什么仍然重要。
他最锋利的观点是：团队之所以有价值，是因为每个人都会用不同的责任去过滤同一个模型。当模型能力广泛可得，默认输出就只是底线。真正稀缺的，是那个能判断什么重要、然后采取行动的人。
original: 自动化之后人类工作的新愿景
